name: cihou-small-world-v10-art-direction
purpose: Original restrained ink-and-gouache 3D picture-book hero. Geometry, camera, contact, occlusion and recurring landmark supply the story. Images supply only a common surface language.

palette.girl: Use the warm red and chestnut colors already painted in girl-rig-parts-v5.png unchanged

materialRules: Two or three broad color values per material; matte opaque gouache; subtle grain only. No embossed wrinkles, busy white streaks, glitter, glow or AO black halos.
Fine ink only around selected silhouettes and one or two useful structure lines. No triangle wireframe and no equal border on every road edge.
One soft directional light from upper-left; all cast shadows lower-right. A tiny grounded foot-contact shadow supports every stance.
Warm pink belongs to a rare exposed paper edge or reflected warm light, not a uniform outline around the whole loop.
Keep paint detail at one consistent world scale: do not use huge brush marks on the road and tiny photoreal grain on the stone.
spatialComposition: Begin with a local walk view: road enters offscreen bottom-left, passes the central feet, exits offscreen upper-right. The girl is a small living subject in a traversable place.
Place one cropped irregular foreground branch at an edge only if it truly occludes the world; stay under 12 percent of the frame. Do not frame every side with decorative plants.
One distinctive tilted stone and one flower define the middle ground. One or two pale low terrain planes define the distance.
A continuous road can become a natural arched half-twist bridge. Reveal the reversed surface relationship once in a later pullback; avoid a full-size flat ring dominating the whole experience.
Recognize the return through the same tilted stone silhouette and flower asymmetry before reading the whole loop. Camera parallax should move near, middle and far ground at distinct rates.

stone.shape: Asymmetric low wedge with a slanted cut. One broad lit top face, one broad cool shadow face, one short angled crack; never a generic sphere or three identical rocks.

flower.shape: Single slim ink stem leans inward toward the road, two unequal matte olive leaves, one flower with three broad asymmetric ochre petals and one dark heart; lower petal has a small notch. No five-petal emoji and no three identical branches.
flower.identity: The same geometry/material/relative petal arrangement must appear on the original stem, at the hand, at the bag and at the ending. A specific recognizable object recurs, not an unrelated generic seed particle.

narrativeStaging: Allow head/eyes to lead attention, then bend hips and knees, make fingertip contact, transfer the exact visible flower and regain weight. Keep ground contact readable.
The visible recurring flower can supply the causal connection across local view, ring revelation and departure. Every transition must preserve its identity.
Let the final viewpoint show the act and its consequence clearly, then settle. Avoid dissolving into an empty blue logo or particle bloom.

assets.materialReplacement: paper-road-v10 replaces paper-road-v1 for the new true 3D surface. Old assets are preserved.

authorship: Art production notes only; not an independent review or a benchmark score.
